about.title: About Me
about.description:
Hello, I’m Pham Quoc Hoa, a software developer based in Vietnam. I graduated with a degree in Computer Engineering from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology. I have over 2 years of professional experience in software development, specializing in Front End development for both web and mobile applications.

Through real-world projects, I have gained hands-on experience in building web and mobile applications, focusing on performance, usability, and scalability to deliver user-centered products.

wisebuddy.title: WISE Buddy
wisebuddy.description: The AI app for English learning and speaking. Users can practice daily communication and improve reflexes by conversing with various AI characters, providing a natural and interactive learning experience.
wisebuddy.responsibilities: Developed message chat and voice chat features for English learning through AI conversation.

indochina.title: Indochina Enterprises
indochina.description: The app is the ultimate shopping app designed for wholesale customers such as restaurants, hotels, and food stalls. We built a B2B wholesale app enabling businesses to place orders on credit, manage debt through reminders and payments, and handle preorders for unavailable items.
indochina.responsibilities: Developed a wholesale platform with credit options, handling order placement, payments, and tracking.

camxu.title: CamXu
camxu.description: The app supports for learning Chinese, focusing on developing all 4 skills: listening, speaking, reading, writing. Features include: themed learning, multiple-choice tests, essay tests, audio recording tests.
camxu.responsibilities: Developed many features: multiple-choice tests, audio learning, essay tests, audio recording tests, and themed learning modules for a comprehensive Chinese learning experience.
